Page counts, page size, metadata and form state from pdfinfo; embedded-image counts from `pdfimages -list`. Delivered text page by page from `pdftotext -layout -f N -l N`. (3) The overlap detector was controlled with TWO DISTINCT WORDS (ALPHAWORD/BRAVOWORD) at near-identical Tm, precisely because identical words can be coalesced by pdftotext into one word that cannot overlap anything: it returns overlapFractionOfSmaller 0.987 and pdftotext keeps them separate. (5) The vocabulary scans were controlled on the PRE-REPAIR bytes of these same two families, where they return 7 and 5. The nine completeness counters still read allNineZero true on both families -- they could not see any of this either.

1_buildVocabularyInAuthorCreatorProducer.BUTTHESCOPEISWIDERTHANEITHERPRIORLANESAI: VF47 and FIX149 both scope this class as Author/Creator/Producer. C.Cr.P. art. 976) - canonical' and the boundary fixture reads '- boundary'. 1_buildVocabularyInAuthorCreatorProducer.andItIsStructurallyUNGUARDED: assertNoBuildIdentifierOnAFiledPage() scans page TEXT.
